title: AC control/response to a CleanSwitch command
description: Payload of <identity>/<thing>/control/response, the answer to control/request {"CleanSwitch": 0|1, "Timestamp": ...}. Only CleanSwitch commands are captured in this profile; other controls are expected to echo their own field instead of CleanSwitch (not captured).
x-note: The answer is identical in shape and in CleanSwitch/Error for a start the unit carried out and for a start it did not carry out (7 starts on 2026-09-17: 3 cleaned, 4 did not, all answered CleanSwitch 1, Error 0). Only the next status/response shows whether the unit started. See tests/fixtures/observed_2026_09_17_freeze_clean/README.md.

CleanSwitch.x-note: echo of the value sent in control/request

Error.x-note: 0 also when the unit did not start

TaskID.x-note: the library's per-session control counter echoed back (1, 2, 3, 4 in the order sent)

RequestTimestamp.x-note: echo of Timestamp in control/request (epoch seconds)

Timestamp.x-note: epoch seconds; 0 or 1 s after RequestTimestamp
